title: 赊销订单的信用占用与禁运目的国: opening 7,000 + portion 4,000 > 10,000 → decision → activate; embargoed order stays draft
deviations: Order A's portion of 4,000.00 is 70 % of 5,714.29 (100 PCS at 5,714.29 USD per 100, HALF_UP to cents): the design's 4,000 with its 30/70 terms; P1 is 1,714.29.

The two orders' destinations come from customer.1's consignee addresses with the countries PTY records (DE; AQ, the synthetic embargo territory) rather than entered by compliance: PTY refuses no country and CNX takes the consignee's (A7 decision 3).

figures.sc09a.quote: payable 571429 USD; cost 56000, profit 515429 USD; margin rule pass; payments P1 171429, P2 400000
figures.sc09b.quote: payable 8000 USD; cost 6000, profit 2000 USD; margin rule pass; payments P1 2400, P2 5600
